# Conformance vectors: where they come from

The `*.json` files here are the Radius Platform policy conformance vectors, copied unchanged
from the public, MIT-licensed repository
[`radiustechsystems/radius-payment-gateway`](https://github.com/radiustechsystems/radius-payment-gateway)
at commit `a34875f53b1b9d5054e76643e7dae21096ed1e00`, directory `tests/vectors/`. That
repository records them as taken from Radius Platform commit
`4566e185546069adcc4955d222a63e91557ca765` (its `tests/vectors/VECTORS_COMMIT`). `LICENSE` is
that repository's licence and covers these files and the port in `../../policy.go` and
`../../eval.go`.

Expectations are written by hand upstream, never generated by an evaluator. Do not edit them
here; to update, copy the files again from a newer commit and change the commits above.

`agent.json` is `radius.policy/0.2`; every other file is `radius.policy/0.1`. 73 cases in all.

Later upstream changes add an `extra` object to payment options in four files (`example`,
`legacy_x402`, `overlapping_endpoints`, `overlapping_endpoints_deny`). The evaluator passes
options through as written, so those versions pass as well; they are not copied here until a
licensed source publishes them.

## Format

Each file is one compiled policy and the cases that run against it. `vectors_test.go` is the
runner.

```jsonc
{
  "description": "what the file covers",
  "policy": { /* a compiled policy, or null for "no policy loaded yet" */ },
  "cases": [
    {
      "name": "…",
      "request": {
        "method": "GET",
        "path": "/tx/0xabc",
        "client_ip": "198.51.100.7",                  // optional
        "caller": { "id": "acct_42" },                // optional: who the seller's auth verified
        "agent": { "category": "…",                   // optional, 0.2: what the gate verified
                   "signature_agent": "https://…" },
        "now": 1760000000                             // Unix seconds
      },
      // Optional: resolve client_ip from the connection or a header, per defaults.client_ip.
      "transport": { "remote_addr": "203.0.113.50", "headers": { "cf-connecting-ip": "10.1.2.3" } },
      "no_policy": "deny",      // only with "policy": null
      "counts": [21, 21],       // each counter's value after adding this request, or
      "counter_error": true,    // every counter failed
      "expected": {
        // Present when the rule has a rate limit or a free quota: the rate limit's counter first.
        "counted": [ { "rule": "…", "limit": "rate_limit", "key": "<uid>:rate:<window>:ip:…", "reset_s": 40 } ],
        "decision": {
          "rule": "…",                   // null when no rule matched
          "type": "payment_required",    // allow | deny | payment_required
          "price": "0.001", "description": "…", "accepts": [ /* the action's options */ ],
          "status": 429, "code": "rate_limited",          // deny only
          "headers": { "RateLimit-Limit": "60" }          // absent when there are none
        }
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

`../three_options.json` is not a vector: it is a document compiled by the Platform on
2026-11-20 for a test project (ids and the seller address replaced), with one made-up field
added to an option, to check that three options with `extra` load and pass through untouched.
